Backend: 14/14 pytest cases in tests/test_signatures.py pass (preview/create 400 without firmas, create 200 with firmas (pdf_version=1, pdf_label=folio_str, mail_status=no_configurado), invalid png rejected, PUT /entries/{id} 400 without firmas and creates v2 with label '<folio> - v2', GET /versions returns both versions sorted desc, GET /versions/1/pdf byte-identical before/after edit (immutability), GET /entries/{id}/pdf returns latest (differs from v1), legacy entry: GET /pdf and POST /send -> 409, POST /sign creates v1 and second /sign -> 409). Frontend (Playwright): full 8-step wizard with new 'Firmas' step 7 — Resumen button says 'Continuar a firmas', pads data-testid signature-pad-taller/cliente drawable via mouse, 'Ver vista previa del PDF' disabled until both signed, Limpiar clears, cliente card has legal text + prefilled editable client name; going back to step 0 and editing a field clears both signatures (verified assert disabled on re-entry to Firmas); confirm -> success shows '00004'; detail shows versions-list with v1; edit flow -> re-sign -> confirm -> success shows '00004 - v2'; detail now lists v2 + v1; legacy entry (seeded in mongo folio 09002) shows versions-empty + versions-sign-btn; Descargar PDF redirects to /entradas/:id/firmar (sign-entry-page), signing + preview + 'Todo correcto, guardar PDF' returns to detail with v1 listed. Previous iteration regression suite (backend_test.py) remains intact.
critical_code_review_comments: SignaturePad: the useEffect that initializes the canvas and attaches touchmove/touchstart passive:false listeners runs only once on mount; if the canvas is resized (e.g., viewport rotation on tablet) the DPR-scaled bitmap and context transform are stale. Consider a ResizeObserver.

NewEntry.setData wipes firmas on EVERY setData call. In practice this is fine (every edit really does require re-signing), but note it also clears signatures when the user merely re-enters a field with the same value (onChange fires). Minor UX nitpick, matches spec.

pdf_versions.firmas stores the full base64 PNG of both signatures per version; each version adds ~2x PNG payload to Mongo in addition to the GridFS PDF. For large archives consider referencing the PNGs by hash or dropping them (they are already embedded in the stored PDF).
get_version uses a conditional spread {** ({'version': v} if v else {})}: if a caller ever passes v=0 it falls through to 'latest', which is probably not intended. Minor.
No DELETE/undo for pdf_versions (by design) — operations/support staff cannot remove a bad PDF; document this limitation.
